name: Joe Prunty
transactions: Appointed Interim Head Coach by the Milwaukee Bucks.
Appointed Interim Head Coach by the Atlanta Hawks.
Hired as Interim Head Coach by the Milwaukee Bucks.

stints.note: Joe Prunty coached three games while Nate McMillan was in health and safety protocols from January 1; Chris Jent is reported to have taken over from the January 9 game against the Clippers. The handover is not pinned game by game.
